data.script: Ingrid: Okay team, Saturday plans! How about tennis in the morning? … Diego: Hmm, the courts are closed on Saturday. What about the pool? … Ingrid: The pool opens at ten. Perfect for the morning! … Diego: And in the afternoon? Shall we go to the cinema? … Ingrid: Maya prefers the science museum. There's a new dinosaur room! … Diego: Dinosaurs win! Cinema next week instead. … Ingrid: So: pool at ten, sandwiches at one, dinosaurs at three. … Diego: And ice cream at five. Every good plan ends with ice cream!
